arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import datetime as dt
from humanize import naturaldelta, naturaltime

# Test with very large timedelta
huge = dt.timedelta(days=999999999)
print('naturaldelta huge:', repr(naturaldelta(huge)))
print('naturaltime huge:', repr(naturaltime(huge)))

# Test with normal timedeltas to make sure we didn't break anything
normal = dt.timedelta(hours=5)
print('naturaldelta normal:', repr(naturaldelta(normal)))
print('naturaltime normal:', repr(naturaltime(normal)))

# Test past datetime
past = dt.datetime.now() - dt.timedelta(hours=2)
print('naturaltime past:', repr(naturaltime(past)))
"
